name: Adrianna Brodi
source:
"Lives with her foster dad. She has no information regarding her biological parents. Her foster mother died shortly after Adrianna, as a child, was assigned to her new family.
She's very athletic and takes part in official sport events, but still considers herself an introvert. She's open to love and romance, although she hasn't found the ideal partner yet.
Adrianna is interested in anything space-related, but would rather focus on sports, her main passion. Being with her means exercising a lot and always doing something physical."

[In-game description]
